PowerShell(Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing; Get-ChildItem public, src\\assets -File | ForEach-Object { try { $i=[System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile\($_.FullName\); "{0}`t{1}x{2}`t{3} KB" -f $_.Name,$i.Width,$i.Height,[math]::Round\($_.Length/1KB\); $i.Dispose\(\) } catch { "{0}`t\(not an image / unreadable\)`t{1} KB" -f $_.Name,[math]::Round\($_.Length/1KB\) } }; python --version)
